fixes.behavior: Card checkout fails closed for loading, unreadable or enabled-but-incomplete terminal settings. Successful reads of both explicitly disabled providers allow manual card. Settings are serialized and the cashier-confirmed configuration is checked after a fresh read and before dispatch. Cash, training and zero-due loyalty remain available.

Per-provider promises coalesce duplicate requests and queue different providers serially. Every caller gets its requested provider result. All-provider requests await all requested work and aggregate provider-specific errors even if a pass unexpectedly rejects.
fixes.limit: Concurrent provider scope is isolated deterministically in automated production-module tests. Native restart recovery also has a periodic all-provider sweep, terminal lease and four-minute owner grace; it cannot independently isolate the startup race.
